incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx and latency spikes on runtime-prod in us-west-2 (backpressure thresholds hit)

jessica (oncall): ack, I'm looking. seeing a huge influx from a handful of client tokens — traffic is spiky but concentrated.

omar (sre): on it. can you dump the top tokens/ips? I want to check for retry storms or bad clients.

jessica (oncall): pasted top tokens to the channel: token:A12... (45% of error volume), token:B99... (22%). many connections with concurrent streams ~50 each.

marco (sdk): that looks like a misconfigured SDK in the wild — older SDK version doesn't implement jittered backoff and retries aggressively.

kate (platform): if it's concentrated we can do a soft-shaping policy at the edge per-token to avoid wider service impact. propose: 1) apply per-token rate cap to these tokens, 2) enable 429 ramp-down for streaming endpoints, 3) temporarily disable server-side realtime features for free-tier tenants.

jessica (oncall): agree. action plan: a) add per-token soft-limit of 10 rps for the two heavy tokens, b) set 429 with Retry-After header for streaming start requests, c) notify CS. Any objections?

omar (sre): no objections. implement soft-limit first (no hard blocks) — allow small burst but return 429 for steady excess. we'll watch latency.

eng-release-bot: deploy triggered: edge-rate-policy v2 -> canary to us-west-2 (2 nodes)

jessica (oncall): rolling canary deployed to us-west-2 canary nodes. monitoring...

omar (sre): can see per-token TPS drop on those tokens, overall 5xx rate down 60% on canary nodes. queue latency improving.

ryan (cust-suc): pinging the customer owners for token:A12 and token:B99 to ask for updates and share mitigation steps.

marco (sdk): sending an urgent SDK patch to blocky clients to implement exponential backoff + jitter. sample recommended pattern (JS):

```js
// exponential backoff with full jitter
async function retryWithBackoff(fn, attempts = 5) {
  for (let i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (err) {
      if (i === attempts - 1) throw err;
      const base = Math.min(1000 * 2 ** i, 10000);
      const sleep = Math.random() * base; // full jitter
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, sleep));
    }
  }
}
```

marco (sdk): also strongly recommend clients add an Idempotency-Key header for non-idempotent operations and reduce parallel streaming connections to <10 per token.

jessica (oncall): mitigation 1 applied. starting step 2: flip streaming ramp-down config to return 429 at 1.2x baseline for new stream creations.

omar (sre): monitoring metrics — new stream creations fell by ~70%, aggregate concurrency down by ~40%. 5xx rate across region down to near baseline.

ryan (cust-suc): exchanged notes with token:A12 owner; they confirmed a rollback of a buggy retry loop is in progress. they expect fix in ~30m. thanks for the heads up.

kate (platform): FYI we also toggled a temporary quota override so other tenants don't get impacted while these tokens are shaped. ended up lowering default burst to protect the runtime.

jessica (oncall): next: coordinate handoff to night oncall in 45m. I'll prepare a short summary for the handoff: what happened, mitigations applied, tokens being shaped, SDK advisory.

marco (sdk): please include this snippet for customers to paste (curl):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

marco (sdk): and this header handling: if you get 429, read Retry-After and back off with jitter. if you get 5xx, apply exponential backoff and limit concurrency.

jessica (oncall): handoff note prepared. final checks: all canaries healthy, region metrics stable. leaving shaping active for 1h, will reassess before escalation to full block. tagging @ops-night for visibility.

omar (sre): thumbs up. also opened incident ticket INC-2027-547 with timeline and mitigation steps.

ryan (cust-suc): I've updated the customers and they appreciate the proactive measures. we'll follow up post-incident with SDK advisory and changelog.

jessica (oncall): :white_check_mark: closing the active pager. will hand off in 40m with status: degraded -> mitigated (shaping active).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2027-547 status changed to mitigated by jessica (oncall).
